hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "nvim/.*\.lua"; then stylua --check nvim/.config/nvim 2>&1; fi'

bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "(hosts\.yml|\.credentials\.json|\.env|id_ed25519|id_rsa|allowed_signers)"; then echo "BLOCKED: This file contains credentials or sensitive data. Remove from .gitignore allowlist first." >&2; exit 1; fi'
